protocol: FedBCert E27 frozen structural-information granularity audit
purpose: Measure how conservative endpoint-blind ledger representations affect a final retained-mass pairwise plus ReLU-cone certificate while keeping predictor states, logits, completion semantics, and evaluation nodes fixed.

fixed_certificate.certificate: union of retained-mass pairwise and ReLU-cone one-sided certificates
fixed_certificate.count_semantics: actual boundary count is any integer no greater than the represented safe upper bound

representation_cost.exact: hat_b_iv=b_iv; client i uses B_i(1)=ceil(log2(max(2,b_i_max+1))) bits for every local node, including the zero code
representation_cost.binned: for s in {2,4,8}, hat_b_iv=s*ceil(b_iv/s), so b_iv=0 remains zero; B_i(s)=ceil(log2(max(2,ceil(b_i_max/s)+1))) bits per local node
representation_cost.presence: one bit per node; zero gives delta=0 and positive gives the safe worst-case row budget delta=2 (retained mass zero), without pretending that presence alone is a finite count upper bound
representation_cost.client_max: hat_b_iv=b_i_max for every local node; store one B_i(1)-bit scalar per client
representation_cost.universal: no ledger; delta=2 and retained mass zero for every node
representation_cost.aggregation: within a unit, bits/node is total client-local ledger bits divided by total nodes; Table 2 averages this unit value over the 30 frozen units
